I farm a wheat-maize rotation, so I will use the same 2 mu for winter wheat and then summer maize. Because I have well irrigation, I will not farm too loosely, but at my age I also will not choose a very labor-heavy plan. I will use seed that gives me stable yield, put on enough fertilizer to protect production, irrigate at the key stages, and keep pesticide use to what is necessary to avoid losing the crop. For wheat, I will stay with improved seed and manage it in the usual local way with moderate fertilizer, two irrigations, and rotary tillage because it is easier for me on a small plot. For maize, I will use hybrid seed because maize responds well to it, and I will also keep fertilizer and water at a medium level so the crop can yield well without making the work too heavy. I am aiming for stable harvests more than risk.
